testsuite.name: com.bontecou.syncmd.services.git.lfs.LfsNetworkIntegrationTest

testcase.name: separate endpoint credentials and repository changes during approval stop lock writes
global attributes and credential record revision invalidate lock confirmation
failed object verification prevents publishing the Git commit and retains local edits
changed ownership cannot silently turn ordinary release into a force release
successful merge hydrates new pointer and failed download reports completed merge
corrupt download cannot replace pointer or publish corrupt cache
completed fast forward reports LFS attention when object download fails
lockCreationRejectsReplacementWorkingFolderWithOriginalMetadata
forceReleaseRejectsReplacementWorkingFolderWithOriginalMetadata
index lock held by another client prevents hydration from replacing working pointer
read only listing never authorizes a mutation and shows the fetch URL
confirmed write with failed refresh is distinct from an unconfirmed write reply
create list and unlock retain opaque identifiers Unicode cursors ref and force semantics
cached branch checkout remains offline without a configured remote
new branch and tag do not claim unmodified locked files already published on another ref
redirected object requests stop without forwarding action credentials
reviewed lock creation and release preserve local content index and refs
paused rebase hydrates nonconflicting files and returns a fresh resumable session
malformed ownership duplicate locks and repeated cursors cannot bypass verification
external edits during download survive while verified cache remains reusable
resolved LFS conflict remains staged on download failure and can hydrate without resolving again
LFS conflict chooses a whole pointer side hydrates it and keeps the staged pointer
branch switch downloads missing objects using the branch remote and keeps pointer index
destination created during lock verification is not overwritten even by force push
lock preflight needs only push advertisement on a write only Git endpoint
real HTTPS clone hydrates stage cleans push verifies and pull hydrates new objects
corrupt cached pointer content can be downloaded and repaired without trusting old bytes
branch switch protects external edits during object download
lockReleaseRejectsReplacementWorkingFolderWithOriginalMetadata
batch omissions and duplicate JSON are rejected before object replacement
real HTTP LFS clone upload verify and pull preserve pointers and bytes
cancelled lock review stops before requesting another page
clone hydration warning preserves an edit made during LFS download
review rejects changed branch attributes and credentials before server writes
foreign lock on later page blocks before object upload and retry keeps the same local commit
branch switch download failure keeps changed branch and allows independent LFS retry
rebase completed before download failure returns attention without retrying history rewrite
clone with a rejected LFS object redirect keeps the pointer without forwarding credentials
completed rebase hydrates upstream pointer and retains replayed local work
HTTP corruption cannot replace pointer or cache
clone retains completed Git history when LFS object verification fails and hydration can retry
only unsupported locking responses allow push while auth redirects and server errors fail closed
HTTP redirect does not receive object credentials and leaves pointer intact
